overview_description.description:
Scribe helps sales teams, marketing teams, support teams and hyper productive individuals save upto ~2 hours of time each day! Scribe let's you convert any app into a custom Slack Bot, within 10 mins. Scribe is used by people at Salesforce, Uber, General Assembly and other top companies, and we're backed by Y Combinator. 

This In-Slack Bot brings emails, CRMs, calendars, payment systems - your whole stack to Slack! It powers these apps with actions buttons - so you can take an action in Slack and it will automatically reflect in any app you choose! For example, if you want to log an email in Zendesk or Salesforce, it will take one click in Slack to do this.

Looking for early adopters, unicorns, folks who're genuinely passionate about improving efficiency and always on the lookout for the next best tool. If you're reading this and know you're the one- please do reach out- your honest feedback could literally turn a good product into a great one!

Email us at rutika.muchhala@tryscribe.com to learn more!
